bug_semantics: Pipeline: Groovy Libraries checks out attacker-controlled shared-library SCM onto the Jenkins controller and copies src/**/*.groovy, vars/*.groovy, vars/*.txt, and resources/ into the build's libs/ tree without rejecting symbolic links or other non-regular files. copyRecursiveTo preserves those symlinks. UserDefinedGlobalVariable.getHelpHtml() then FileUtils.readFileToString()s libs/<lib>/vars/<var>.txt for the global-variable help page, following a planted symlink (for example vars/leak.txt -> /etc/passwd or $JENKINS_HOME/secrets/master.key) and returning arbitrary controller file contents. libraryResource had a later canonical-path check (SECURITY-2476) that blocked only that step; vars/*.txt help and other FilePath reads remained open until retrieve-time rejection was added.
flaw_origin: Missing CWE-59 check from the first SCM shared-library loader. 62281a93828713fec238c29f34bdee420ac5c03a (2016-08-16, Jesse Glick) introduced LibraryAdder: controller checkout plus srcDir.zip(**/*.groovy), varsDir.zip(*.groovy,*.txt), and resourcesDir.zip with no symlink prohibition. That packaging was later refactored to unpacked copyRecursiveTo of the same globs and moved into SCMSourceRetriever then SCMBasedRetriever, but the missing reject persisted until SECURITY-3727.

The immediate parent 30e761b89ec3bb01dde21299a2335de550e3ef13 has no LibraryAdder and no checkout/zip/copy of those trees, confirmed by cat-file. Later ce623b82 (unpacked copyRecursiveTo plus File-based GlobalVars), e8a10e89 (LibraryRetriever move), and 76ad53e0 (SCMBasedRetriever factor-out) are storage/API refactors of the same globs, so they are not BICs.
